_comment: Config for check-corpus.py and check-client-copy.py. price_ok lists where a figure may appear, each with its reason. CLAUDE.md and non-negotiables.md name the categories; this names the paths. If they disagree, fix both in one commit.

price_ok.client-facing/: the send surface; figures must match commercial.md
price_ok.clients/: custom-offer.md and [contracted] lines only; other figures are flagged
price_ok.tasks/: a task may exist because a figure was wrong
price_ok.NEEDS.md: struck rows record what a figure used to be
price_ok.SETUP-PROGRESS.md: setup notes may name a figure the founder gave
